text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "board committee", "gist": "board committee"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Pascal Richoz", "gist": "Pascal Richoz"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Pascal Richoz (*1963), lic. ès lettres, holds a CAS in public sector financial management and has headed the Working Conditions Division since 1 September 2008.", "gist": "Pascal Richoz (born 1963), with a lic. ès lettres, holds a CAS in public sector financial management and has led the Working Conditions Division since 1 September 2008."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Having begun his career at the Fribourg cantonal administration, he started working for the federal government in 1989.", "gist": "Pascal Richoz began his career at the Fribourg cantonal administration and joined the federal government in 1989."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "He is active in the area of international protection and has performed various roles on behalf of the Refugees Delegate, the Federal Office for Refugees and the Federal Office for Migration.", "gist": "Pascal Richoz works in international protection and has held various roles for the Refugees Delegate, Federal Office for Refugees, and Federal Office for Migration."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Before joining SECO, he was in charge of an Asylum Procedure Division.", "gist": "Before joining SECO, Pascal Richoz led an Asylum Procedure Division."}]}
